title: Your least favourite movie
titleVi: Bộ phim bạn ít thích nhất
bullets: and explain why it's your least favourite movie

notes.label: Where
notes.text: cinema near home, with my cousin

notes.label: Why worst
notes.text: flat characters, clichés, cash grab, ripped off

segments.v: I want to talk about my least favourite movie. It was a science-fiction movie. I watched it last summer at the cinema near my house with my cousin. We liked the first movie very much so we wanted to watch the second one. The movie was about heroes who fight aliens. But the story was very boring and confusing. The movie was very long, about two and a half hours. There were too many fighting scenes. The characters were not interesting and I didn't care about them. The ending was not good. The ticket was expensive so I felt disappointed. It is my least favourite movie because the story was bad. Now I always read reviews before I watch a movie.
